data.long_meaning: One who is established and firm in his beliefs and actions, a fortress or protector for others. The name Masroof carries the meaning “Fortress, Protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Masroof usually hope their child will grow to embody fortress, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who is steadfast in his faith and provides protection and security to those around him
data.etymology: Masroof belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fortress, Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Masroof total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: مصروف
in_arabic.long_meaning: المصروف من الأموال والمعاش هو الشخص الذي يُستخدم ماله في طاعة الله، والتصرف في أمواه مع إعطاء العطاء لغيره، ويُعتبر مصروفاً الشخص الذي يُستخدم ماله في الطاعة والعمل الخيري لصالح المسلمين، وإن كان مصروفاً فهو في طاعة الله، وإن كان غير مصروف فهو في إثماً

in_urdu.name: مصروف
in_urdu.meaning: مصروف کے معانی میں مالی معاشیات کا استعمال اور معاش کا وصول شامل ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مصروف اُس شخص کے لئے کہا جاتا ہے جو اپنی آمدنی اور دولت کا استعمال معاشرتی خیرات کے لیے کرتا ہے، اور اپنے مال اور دولت کا استعمال اللہ کی رضا کے لیے کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मस्रूफ
in_hindi.meaning: मस्रूफ शब्द से तात्पर्य है आय का व्यय और आय का प्राप्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: मस्रूफ एक व्यक्ति होता है जो अपने पैसे को खैरात के लिए खर्च करता है, और अपने धन का उपयोग अल्लाह की رضا के लिए करता है।

in_pashto.name: مصروف
in_pashto.meaning: د مالي توکول او د معاش وصول
in_pashto.long_meaning: د مصروف دا مانس هم دا دی چې د مالي توکول او د معاش وصول ورسره په کار کوي، او د خیراتو لپاره په کار کوي

data.cultural_impact: The name "Masroof" signifies a strong and unwavering character in the Islamic cultural context. It is often given to children as a reminder to uphold strong moral values and to establish a solid foundation in their beliefs and actions. This name not only inspires respect and admiration within the community but also serves as a symbol of resilience and protection, especially in times of hardship or adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Masroof" holds great significance as it reflects the ideal Islamic character of being firmly rooted in faith and compelling in one's actions. This name signifies a commitment to live up to one's moral values and to stand steadfast in the face of trials and tribulations. A person named Masroof is seen as a protector and a fortress for their loved ones, as well as a source of guidance and inspiration for others in the community. This name serves as a constant reminder of the importance of holding on to one's faith and remaining steadfast in the footsteps of Allah SWT.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Fortress, Protector" symbolizes One who is established and firm in his beliefs and actions, a fortress or protector for others. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Masroof serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of fortress, protector.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Masroof was an Umayyad governor of Egypt in the 7th century. The name Masroof carried significant weight in that era.
